newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine cash soy down after Chicago.
newsitem.headline: Argentine cash soy down after Chicago.

text.p: Argentine cash soybeans were lower midsession Monday at the Buenos Aires Cereals Exchange, shadowing a dip in nearby Chicago, traders said.

FAS elevator soybeans for Rosario lost $3 to $294. Soybean volume was moderate. FAS elevator maize was unchanged at $106 in Buenos Aires, with little of novelty in the market. Supply was short with some sellers holding on to grain in the hope that local poultry producers will enter the market soon and give exporters some competition. Sunflower seed rose $2 in Buenos Aires to $230 in tight trade, with improved crush margins feeding through to bids. Quequen wheat was steady at $147.
